```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
packages <- c("sf", "spdep", "dplyr", "leaflet", "htmltools", "knitr")
missing <- packages[!packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(missing) > 0) install.packages(missing, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")

library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
library(knitr)
```

# Data

```{r data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data_url <- "https://github.com/CienciaDeDatosEspacial/dataSets/raw/refs/heads/main/PERU/PeruMaps.gpkg"
value_col <- "Educ_sec_comp2019_pct"
alpha <- 0.05

peru <- st_read(data_url, layer = "good_geom", quiet = TRUE)
lima <- peru %>%
  filter(toupper(DEPARTAMENTO) == "LIMA", !is.na(.data[[value_col]])) %>%
  st_transform(4326)

lima_proj <- st_transform(lima, 32718)
nrow(lima)
```

# Vecindarios

```{r neighborhoods}
coords <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(lima_proj))

queen_nb <- poly2nb(lima_proj, queen = TRUE)
rook_nb <- poly2nb(lima_proj, queen = FALSE)
knn4_nb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 4))

nearest <- knearneigh(coords, k = 1)
distance_threshold <- ceiling(max(unlist(nbdists(knn2nb(nearest), coords))) / 1000) * 1000
distance_nb <- dnearneigh(coords, d1 = 0, d2 = distance_threshold)

neighborhoods <- list(
  "Queen / interseccion" = queen_nb,
  "Rook / frontera compartida" = rook_nb,
  "KNN 4 centroides" = knn4_nb,
  "Banda distancia" = distance_nb
)
```

# Calculo LISA

```{r lisa}
label_order <- c("1 hotOutlier", "2 hotSpot", "3 no_pattern", "4 coldSpot", "5 coldOutlier")
colors <- c(
  "1 hotOutlier" = "#b35806",
  "2 hotSpot" = "#f1a340",
  "3 no_pattern" = "#e6e6e6",
  "4 coldSpot" = "#998ec3",
  "5 coldOutlier" = "#542788"
)

clean_prefix <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(x)
  x <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", x)
  gsub("^_|_$", "", x)
}

classify_lisa <- function(values, nb) {
  lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
  lm <- localmoran_perm(values, lw, nsim = 999, zero.policy = TRUE)
  z <- as.numeric(scale(values))
  lag_z <- lag.listw(lw, z, zero.policy = TRUE)
  p <- lm[, "Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim"]

  cls <- rep("3 no_pattern", length(values))
  sig <- p <= alpha
  cls[sig & z > 0 & lag_z > 0] <- "2 hotSpot"
  cls[sig & z < 0 & lag_z < 0] <- "4 coldSpot"
  cls[sig & z > 0 & lag_z < 0] <- "1 hotOutlier"
  cls[sig & z < 0 & lag_z > 0] <- "5 coldOutlier"

  list(label = factor(cls, levels = label_order), moran_i = lm[, "Ii"], p = p, n = card(nb))
}

results <- list()
summary_rows <- list()

for (nm in names(neighborhoods)) {
  prefix <- clean_prefix(nm)
  calc <- classify_lisa(lima[[value_col]], neighborhoods[[nm]])
  temp <- lima
  temp[[paste0(prefix, "_lisa")]] <- calc$label
  temp[[paste0(prefix, "_moran_i")]] <- calc$moran_i
  temp[[paste0(prefix, "_p")]] <- calc$p
  temp[[paste0(prefix, "_n")]] <- calc$n
  results[[prefix]] <- temp

  counts <- table(factor(calc$label, levels = label_order))
  summary_rows[[nm]] <- data.frame(
    vecindario = ifelse(nm == "Banda distancia", paste0("Banda distancia ", distance_threshold / 1000, " km"), nm),
    vecinos_promedio = mean(card(neighborhoods[[nm]])),
    islas = sum(card(neighborhoods[[nm]]) == 0),
    t(as.data.frame.matrix(t(counts))),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

summary_df <- bind_rows(summary_rows)
kable(summary_df)
```

# Ultimo mapa LISA: solo Lima

```{r last-map}
make_map <- function(gdf, prefix, title) {
  pal <- colorFactor(palette = colors, domain = label_order)
  leaflet(gdf) %>%
    addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
    addPolygons(
      color = "#303030",
      weight = 0.35,
      fillOpacity = 0.78,
      fillColor = ~pal(.data[[paste0(prefix, "_lisa")]]),
      label = ~HTML(paste0(
        "<b>", DISTRITO, "</b><br>",
        "Provincia: ", PROVINCIA, "<br>",
        "Clase LISA: ", .data[[paste0(prefix, "_lisa")]], "<br>",
        value_col, ": ", round(.data[[value_col]], 2), "<br>",
        "p-value: ", round(.data[[paste0(prefix, "_p")]], 4), "<br>",
        "Vecinos: ", .data[[paste0(prefix, "_n")]]
      ))
    ) %>%
    addLegend(position = "bottomleft", pal = pal, values = label_order, title = title)
}

make_map(results$queen_interseccion, "queen_interseccion", "LISA Lima - Queen / interseccion")
```

# Dashboard: cuatro vecindarios

La tabla anterior resalta las diferencias en conteos por clase LISA. Los mapas siguientes usan la misma data y la misma variable; solo cambia el cálculo de vecindarios.

```{r dashboard, fig.height=8}
make_map(results$queen_interseccion, "queen_interseccion", "Queen / interseccion")
make_map(results$rook_frontera_compartida, "rook_frontera_compartida", "Rook / frontera compartida")
make_map(results$knn_4_centroides, "knn_4_centroides", "KNN 4 centroides")
make_map(results$banda_distancia, "banda_distancia", paste0("Banda distancia ", distance_threshold / 1000, " km"))
```

```{r export}
write.csv(summary_df, "resumen_lisa_lima_4_vecindarios_r.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
```
